text.p: These were the main headlines on Latvia's state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition Social democrats call for early parliament elections. There has been no reaction from President Guntis Ulmanis.
- Latvian Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs left for a two-day official visit to the Check republic.
- March 31 to be announced a public holiday already this year, parliament press office says.

- Latvian Shipping is the biggest contributor of the social tax payments, a newspaper report says. It paid 4.3 million in 1996 into the state coffers. Ventspils Nafta, Latvjas Finieris and Lauma textile company are also at the top of the list.
